run_compiler_gym_loop_optimization_env: run a CompilerGym loop optimization environment with the loops-opt-py-v0 benchmark and AutophaseDict observation space
create_compiler_gym_environment: create a CompilerGym environment using compiler_gym.make with a specific benchmark and reward space
reset_compiler_gym_env: reset a CompilerGym environment and retrieve the initial observation using env.reset()
sample_random_action_step: sample a random action from the environment action space and step to get observation, reward, done, and info
set_compiler_gym_debug_level: set the CompilerGym debug level using compiler_gym.set_debug_level to control logging verbosity
